hypothesis: When the point-in-time Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey reports no net tightening in C&I lending standards, frozen V11 de-risk events are more likely to be overly defensive. Retaining exactly half of the current V11 reduction should improve return without leverage, while outperforming an availability-matched unconditional half-retention control and preserving V11-like risk quality.

literature_basis.primary: Chava, Gallmeyer, and Park (2015), Credit conditions and stock return predictability, Journal of Monetary Economics, doi:10.1016/j.jmoneco.2015.06.004
literature_basis.out_of_sample_support: Profitable timing of the stock market with the senior loan officer survey, Finance Research Letters (2023)
literature_basis.economic_direction: tighter bank lending standards predict lower subsequent U.S. stock returns; DRTSCILM <= 0 therefore defines the frozen risk-on state

allowed_changes: F-SLOOS-STANDARDS uses only trusted point-in-time ALFRED DRTSCILM releases from 2010Q2 onward; each quarterly value becomes usable release_date + 1 calendar day and persists until the next release
risk-on iff the latest available DRTSCILM value is <= 0; zero is the economic no-net-tightening boundary and is not selected from strategy performance
on a genuine frozen V11 de-risk event, risk-on retains exactly 50% of each asset reduction relative to the previous V11 event target, subject to gross <=100%
risk-off or unavailable leaves the current frozen V11 event target unchanged
selection_metric: No within-family selection. Evaluate the single frozen candidate against frozen V11 and C-SLOOS-ALWAYS. Primary inference uses the common point-in-time window beginning 2010-05-01; full-history product metrics are also reported only for disclosure and cumulative DSR compatibility.
pass_fail_gates: deterministic: at least 4/6 fixed folds candidate Sharpe >= matched-control Sharpe
deterministic: target gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or negative target weights
bootstrap on the 2010-05-01+ common window: paired circular moving blocks, 63 sessions, 20000 replicates, seed 20260822
PBO: not applicable because the family contains exactly one candidate

global post-protocol DSR probability >=95% using all prior 32 formal return-seeking candidates plus F-SLOOS-STANDARDS, total trial count 33; DSR retains the established full-history candidate-return convention and is supplementary to the point-in-time-window gates
ROBUST_FACTOR_PASS requires every applicable deterministic, bootstrap, and global DSR gate
follow_up_policy: This SLOOS campaign contains exactly one retrospective candidate. After formal performance is viewed, do not change the zero threshold, sign, release lag, trusted start, evaluation start, 50% retention fraction, rebalance band, event definition, persistence, survey question, bank-size variant, loan-demand combination, rolling/percentile/z-score transform, asset-specific retention rule, matched control, or gross constraint; do not open a second retrospective SLOOS rescue family. A suggestive non-robust result may only enter a separately preregistered prospective shadow with this exact historical rule.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_sloos_standards_v1.py -> tools/sloos_standards_v1.swiftpart + tools/sloos_standards_v1_logic.swift + immutable tools/orthogonal_event_factor_v3_logic.swift -> frozen V11 source run + BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: V11-CONTROL full-history metrics and frozen target fingerprint
source/de-risk/available/retained event counts and portfolio constraints
factor-library archival with truthful lifecycle after the formal result
run authorization receipt, execution Git commit and SHA-256 result artifact manifest

factor_definition.source: Federal Reserve Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey via ALFRED release vintages
factor_definition.trusted_start_reason: the public ALFRED SLOOS release calendar begins 2010-04-20, so older observations are not relabeled as if their true historical first-release dates were known
factor_definition.state_persistence: the latest released quarterly survey value remains active until the next survey release
factor_definition.interpretation: DRTSCILM is the net percentage of domestic banks tightening C&I standards for large and middle-market firms; values above zero indicate net tightening

strategy_action.eligible_event: a genuine frozen V11 trade event that reduces at least one asset weight relative to the previous frozen V11 event target
strategy_action.risk_on_action: retain exactly 50% of each current event reduction, without increasing any asset above its previous V11 event target and with total gross capped at 100%
strategy_action.risk_off_or_unavailable: use frozen V11 event target unchanged

matched_control.rule: on every SLOOS-available frozen V11 de-risk event, apply the identical 50% retention action regardless of SLOOS state

shared_rules.event_scope: unique execution dates on which frozen V11 report.trades is non-empty

forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 parameter, source, or target-path change
any SLOOS sign reversal or alternate survey series after results
any rolling median, percentile, rank, slope, acceleration, z-score, persistence, or multi-quarter confirmation search
any use of pre-2010Q2 observations as purported first releases
any release-lag relaxation or use of a survey observation before its release date
any retention fraction other than exactly 50%
any factor-driven trade between frozen V11 event dates
any asset-specific or U.S.-only retention tuning after results
any completion-to-100%-gross or financed exposure rescue
candidate replacement or a second retrospective SLOOS candidate after results
dropping failed prior formal candidates from cumulative DSR accounting

statistical_audit.global_dsr_return_window: full history for consistency with prior post-protocol DSR accounting

factor_library_archival.action_after_formal_result: archive the factor definition, preregistration, formal result and evidence in FlyingrtxFast with the truthful lifecycle status
factor_library_archival.robust_pass_policy: may advance only according to the factor-library lifecycle and protocol gates
factor_library_archival.fail_policy: archive as rejected research evidence; never hide the failed trial
